title: Elegant Crisp Filipino Ikura Tinola
description: A fresh and crisp Filipino dish featuring ikura in a papillote, perfect for a romantic evening, and vegan-friendly by substituting traditional chicken with tofu.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and season with salt and black pepper.
In a pan, sauté the sliced onion, minced garlic, and bruised lemongrass in a little oil until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced chili peppers and cook for another minute.
In a bowl, mix the cooked onion mixture, cubed tofu, and ikura.
Place a quarter of the mixture onto the center of each papillote paper, leaving a 1-inch border around the filling.
Fold the paper to form a triangle or a square, and press the edges together to seal the papillote.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Serve the tinola hot, garnished with sliced ginger and a sprinkle of black pepper.
